operations.description:
Allows you to remove a role from a specific user or application key. This method only allows the removal of one role per request. The role's ID must be specified on the request path, not on the request body.

> Note that a successful response returns a `204` response with an empty body. A deletion on a role or user that does not exist will also return a `204`. Thus, this method should not be used to verify the existence of a specific user or role.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] remove rolefrom user [PATH] license manager users roles [PARAMS] content id role type user [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns a list of registered users. The response is divided in pages. The query parameter `numItems` defines the number of items in each page, and consequently the amount of pages for the whole list.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list users [PATH] license manager site pvt logins list paged [PARAMS] content items num number page sort type [SCHEMA] items list paging response user users

operations.description: Returns a list of available roles. The response is divided in pages. The query parameter `numItems` defines the number of items in each page, and consequently the amount of pages for the whole list.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list roles [PATH] license manager site pvt roles list paged [PARAMS] content items num number page sort type [SCHEMA] items list paging product response role roles

operations.description: Allows you to get a user from the database, using the `userId` as the identifier.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] user [PATH] license manager users [PARAMS] content id type user [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Gets roles of a particular user or application key.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] rolesby user [PATH] license manager users roles [PARAMS] content id type user [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Retrieves information from an account, such as company and sponsor user details, stores, and appTokens.

This endpoint only accepts requests from the host list designated for that store. If you want to try this request from this portal, be sure to add it to the list. Learn how to add hosts to the list in [How to manage accounts](https://help.vtex.com/en/tutorial/how-to-manage-accounts--tutorials_6285#).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] account [PATH] vlm account [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account app items key license response site

operations.description: Gets the stores and respective hosts of the account
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] by account [PATH] vlm account stores [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] items store

operations.description: Gets all application keys from an account.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] getappkeysfromaccount [PATH] vlm appkeys [PARAMS] content type [SCHEMA] getappkeysfromaccount

operations.description: Allows you to create a user by providing an email (mandatory) and name (optional). The email must be in a valid format. The success response will contain the generated `userId` for that user.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create user [PATH] license manager users [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] create request user

operations.description: Creates a new pair of `appKey` and `appToken`.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] createnewappkey [PATH] vlm appkeys [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] createnewappkey request response

operations.description: Allows you to add roles to a particular user or application key by specifying the list of roles' IDs on the request's body.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] put rolesin user [PATH] license manager users roles [PARAMS] id user [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Activates or deactivates an `appKey` by its ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] updateappkey [PATH] vlm appkeys [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] error request updateappkey vlm
